title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description** 
 AcoBloom International® is a CoSourcing, technology, and consulting organization supporting accounting firms and businesses across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific, with offices in Dallas, London, Dubai, and nine delivery centers across India. For nearly two decades, the company has operated as an integrated extension of client teams, embedding into their workflows, software, and timelines rather than acting as a traditional outsourcing vendor. AcoBloom delivers bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, tax preparation, audit support, and back\-office operations, complemented by AcoSpark, its AI\-powered finance automation and FP\&A platform. Through Stratrich Consulting, AcoBloom also provides advisory services focused on market entry, entity formation, regulatory navigation, and ongoing corporate services in India and the UAE. As an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified organization working within GDPR, PIPEDA, and APP frameworks, AcoBloom emphasizes data security, compliance, and technology\-driven solutions in the evolving professional services landscape.
 



  





**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: \-** 




  





**Content Creation** 




 Write long\-form blogs, articles, whitepapers, ebooks, case studies, and industry reports
 



 Develop website copy, landing pages, and service pages optimized for search engines and conversions.
 



 Create compelling LinkedIn posts, Social media captions, newsletters, email campaigns and marketing collaterals.
 



 Produce scripts for videos, webinars, podcasts and promotional campaigns
 



 Write customer success stories and testimonials
 



  





**Research and Thought Leadership** 




 Conduct in\-depth research on accounting, taxation, finance, AI, outsourcing, compliance, and technology trends.
 



 Translate technical and industry\-specific topics into engaging content for business audiences.
 



 Support leadership by developing thought leadership articles and executive content.
 



  





**SEO \& Content Optimization** 




 Perform keyword research and incorporate SEO best practices.
 



 Optimize existing content to improve rankings and user engagement.
 



 Work with SEO tools to improve readability and search performance.
 



 Ensure all content aligns with search intent and current content marketing best practices.
 



  





**Content Strategy** 




 Assist in planning and executing monthly content calendars
 



 Identify trending topics and content opportunities across target industries.
 



 Repurpose long\-form content into social media posts, infographics, email campaigns and downloadable assets.
 



  





**Editing \& Quality Assurance** 




 Proofread and edit content for grammar, clarity, tone, consistency, and accuracy.
 



 Ensure brand consistency across all marketing channels
 



 Verify facts, statistics, and references using credible sources.
 



  





**Collaboration** 




 Work closely with designers, digital marketers, product teams, subject matter experts, and sales teams.
 



 Participate in campaign planning and brainstorming sessions.
 


* Coordinate with external contributors when required.
